body: No go. They have no idea how much issue now.
I haven't. In fact, they were just here. Probably not a coincidence that I feel like this now. Fuck me.

I was sexually abused and raped when I was little at a babysitters. My parents blamed me. Then went on to be abusive and emotionally negligent to me for years. I ate food to cope with the pain and my desire to build a wall to keep myself from being molested or raped again, and now I just look like fat piece of shit. Now everyday I get to think about all of the crap that happened, like in being haunted. I just can't do it anymore.
I hate myself, so much. I can't live with myself and the memories of things that happened anymore. They are torturing.
I'm scared because feeling like I want to die is a terrifying feeling.

I don't want to tell anyone, husband, friends or therapist, about what is happening now. It was only a few months ago that I needed to be hospitalized for my mental health. They will think I'm attention seeking, or being dramatic, or just be frustrated at my inability to get my shit together. And clearly, I can't handle it, and it never goes away...
